apps.name: Cipherbook
apps.subtitle: Dual-font EPUB reader
apps.localizedDescription: An EPUB reader that renders every word in two typefaces at once — a main font on the line and a smaller second font directly underneath — for learning a cipher or conscript. Import your own fonts, switch them in two taps, and build custom colour themes.
